title: Apple Arcade levels up with Block Blast!+ and Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+
title_zh: 苹果 Arcade 升级！Block Blast!+ 和 Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+

paragraphs.en: Two new puzzlers, endless ways to play — Block Blast!+ and Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+ come to Apple Arcade on September 3. Whether gamers are looking for high-octane action or a laid-back afternoon, Apple Arcade has a little bit of everything for every player, and its puzzle catalog is getting a big upgrade. On September 3, two standout new titles join the mix: Block Blast!+ and Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+ . Block Blast!+ brings one of the most popular daily puzzle games to Arcade, while the 2025 App Store Award winner for Cultural Impact — Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+ — combines soothing jigsaw-style gameplay with rich storytelling about the natural world. There’s a reason Block Blast!+ has topped charts around the world: It’s simple to pick up and nearly impossible to put down. The game challenges players to slot blocks onto a grid to clear rows and columns, and chase that perfect combo. On Arcade, players can now enjoy the same blockbusting gameplay completely uninterrupted by ads. Block Blast!+ developed by Hungry Studio. With its calming, meditative gameplay and thoughtfully designed accessibility features, Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+ invites players to piece together stunning nature-inspired artwork at their own pace, unlocking stories about wildlife and conservation along the way. Accessibility features make it as welcoming as it is beautiful, proof that a puzzle game can deliver both a fun challenge and a moment of calm. Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+ developed by Klemens Strasser. Block Blast!+ and Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+ join an impressive lineup of puzzlers already keeping Arcade players endlessly entertained, including Grindstone , Flow Free+ , Crossword Jam+ , and recent arrivals Everyday Puzzles: Mini Games+ and Water Sort Puzzle: Get Color+ . Puzzle fans looking for their next obsession can find even more great picks curated on the Arcade tab . The tactical path-tracing gameplay of Grindstone is displayed on iPhone 17 Pro Max. The colorful gameplay of Flow Free+ is displayed on a 13-inch iPad Air. Crossword clues and puzzles in Crossword Jam+ are displayed on iPhone 17 Pro. A menu of game types available on Everyday Puzzles: Mini Games+ is displayed on iPhone 17 Pro. Vials of colored liquid in Water Sort Puzzle: Get Color+ are displayed on a 13-inch iPad Air. Slash, dash, and strategize through dungeons and boss battles in Grindstone. Trace, connect, and untangle colorful pipes in Flow Free+.
paragraphs.zh: 两款全新益智游戏——《Block Blast!+》和《Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+》，玩法无穷无尽，将于 9 月 3 日登陆 Apple Arcade。 无论玩家追求的是高燃刺激的动作体验，还是轻松惬意的午后时光，Apple Arcade 都能为每位玩家提供丰富多样的选择，其益智游戏库也将迎来重大升级。 9 月 3 日，两款备受瞩目的新作将加入其中：《Block Blast!+》和《Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+》。 《Block Blast!+》将最热门的每日益智游戏之一带到了 Arcade，而荣获 2025 年 App Store“文化影响力”奖项的《Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+》，则将舒缓的拼图式玩法与关于自然世界的丰富故事融为一体。 《Block Blast!+》能登顶全球各大排行榜并非偶然：它简单易上手，却让人几乎无法放下。 这款游戏挑战玩家将方块嵌入网格中，以消除整行或整列，并追求完美的连击组合。 现在，Arcade 玩家可以在完全无广告干扰的情况下，享受同样的爽快方块消除体验。 《Block Blast!+》由 Hungry Studio 开发。 《Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+》凭借其宁静冥想般的玩法和精心设计的无障碍功能，邀请玩家按照自己的节奏拼凑出令人惊叹的自然主题艺术作品，同时解锁关于野生动物与环境保护的故事。 其无障碍功能让游戏既美观又包容，证明了一款益智游戏既能带来有趣的挑战，也能让人获得片刻的平静。 《Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+》由 Klemens Strasser 开发。 《Block Blast!+》和《Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+》将加入 Arcade 中已有的众多精彩益智游戏阵容，这些游戏持续为玩家们带来无尽的乐趣，包括《Grindstone》、《Flow Free+》、《Crossword Jam+》，以及近期推出的《Everyday Puzzles: Mini Games+》和《Water Sort Puzzle: Get Color+》。 正在寻找下一款心仪游戏的益智爱好者，可以在 Arcade 标签页中找到更多精心挑选的优质作品。 《Grindstone》的战术路径追踪玩法在 iPhone 17 Pro Max 上呈现。 《Flow Free+》色彩缤纷的玩法在 13 英寸 iPad Air 上呈现。 《Crossword Jam+》中的填字游戏提示和谜题在 iPhone 17 Pro 上呈现。 《Everyday Puzzles: Mini Games+》中多种游戏类型的菜单在 iPhone 17 Pro 上呈现。 《Water Sort Puzzle: Get Color+》中装有彩色液体的小瓶在 13 英寸 iPad Air 上呈现。 在《Grindstone》中，通过斩击、冲刺和策略部署来穿越地牢并挑战首领。 在《Flow Free+》中，追踪、连接并解开色彩缤纷的管道。

paragraphs.en: There’s a reason Block Blast!+ has topped charts around the world: It’s simple to pick up and nearly impossible to put down. The game challenges players to slot blocks onto a grid to clear rows and columns, and chase that perfect combo. On Arcade, players can now enjoy the same blockbusting gameplay completely uninterrupted by ads.
paragraphs.zh: 《Block Blast!+》能登顶全球各大排行榜并非没有原因：它简单易上手，却让人几乎无法放下。 这款游戏要求玩家将方块嵌入网格中，以消除整行或整列，并追求完美的连击效果。 在街机模式中，玩家现在可以完全不受广告干扰地享受同样的方块消除玩法。

paragraphs.en: With its calming, meditative gameplay and thoughtfully designed accessibility features, Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+ invites players to piece together stunning nature-inspired artwork at their own pace, unlocking stories about wildlife and conservation along the way. Accessibility features make it as welcoming as it is beautiful, proof that a puzzle game can deliver both a fun challenge and a moment of calm.
paragraphs.zh: 《Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+》凭借其令人放松、富有冥想感的玩法和精心设计的无障碍功能，邀请玩家按照自己的节奏拼凑出惊艳的自然主题艺术作品，并在过程中解锁关于野生动物与环境保护的故事。 其无障碍功能让游戏既美观又充满包容性，证明了一款益智游戏既能带来有趣的挑战，也能让人获得片刻的宁静。

paragraphs.en: Later this month, updates are coming to other popular games beloved by players. On August 12, puffies. adds 28 new packs that include two collections with artwork for Oden Tomodachi and The Knights. Starting on August 20, Simon’s Cat - Blast Time unleashes 200 new levels, rolling out 50 a week for a month of fresh challenges. And on August 26, stitch. celebrates a huge milestone — 800 unique hoops — with a special commemorative hoop and achievement.
paragraphs.zh: 本月晚些时候，其他深受玩家喜爱的热门游戏也将迎来更新。 8月12日，puffies. 将新增28个包，其中包括包含 Oden Tomodachi 和 The Knights 艺术作品的两个系列。 从8月20日起，Simon’s Cat - Blast Time 将推出200个新关卡，每周发布50个，持续一个月，带来全新的挑战。 到了8月26日，stitch. 将通过一个特别的纪念环和成就来庆祝一个重要里程碑——800个独特的环。

paragraphs.en: This fall is shaping up to be exciting across the board for Arcade. On September 3, additional games joining the fun include NFL Retro Bowl ’27 , which kicks off an epic new season with the high-stakes addition of Gauntlet Mode; Coloring Games for Families+ , a magical world of creativity for players of all ages with over 3,000 engaging activities; and Let’s Play! Oink Games+ , a digital collection of nine tabletop games — from cooperative missions to bluffing cards — playable solo, with friends, or online.
paragraphs.zh: 今年秋季，Arcade 将全面呈现激动人心的内容。 9月3日，更多游戏将加入这场欢乐盛宴，包括《NFL Retro Bowl ’27》，它将开启一个史诗般的新赛季，并加入了充满挑战的“手套模式”；《家庭涂色游戏+》，这是一个为所有年龄段的玩家打造的充满魔力的创意世界，包含超过3000项引人入胜的活动；以及《Let’s Play!》。 《Oink Games+》是一个包含九款桌游的数字合集——从合作任务到 bluffing 卡牌游戏——支持单人、与朋友一起或在线游玩。
